status_notice: Every threshold under planned_acceptance_targets remains a planned acceptance target. A measured development run is recorded below, but it is not a formal holdout result and must not be cited as proof that a planned target was achieved.

v1_scope.secondary_domain: Aggregate HR programme and team-level intervention evaluation
supported_core_methods_planned: randomized two-group tests for binary outcomes
randomized two-group tests for continuous outcomes
regression adjustment or CUPED using pre-treatment variables
out_of_scope_for_v1: individual hiring, firing, promotion, compensation, or performance decisions
automatic causal claims when identification assumptions are not supported
production claims for advanced methods that are not listed as supported core methods

evaluation_principles: Freeze scenario definitions and thresholds before the formal holdout run.
Use known data-generating truth for simulation benchmarks.
Keep development results separate from formal holdout evidence.
Report every family separately; do not use an overall average to hide a weak or unsafe family.
Record failures and inconclusive cases instead of selecting only favourable outputs.
Store a code version, manifest hash, random seed, environment record, and result artifact for every formal run.

split_policy.unit: replication seed within each scenario family

development_split.purpose: implementation, debugging, calibration, and regression testing

holdout_split.purpose: one versioned formal evaluation after code and thresholds are frozen
holdout_split.rerun_policy: A rerun after a code or threshold change creates a new manifest and result version; prior results remain preserved.

fixed_critical_fixtures.purpose: deterministic checks for designs that must be blocked or prominently warned

planned_variations: low, medium, and high baseline conversion
scenario_families.expected_system_behaviour: Estimate uncertainty without converting random noise into a deterministic launch recommendation.

scenario_families.ground_truth: known positive or negative risk difference
scenario_families.expected_system_behaviour: Recover the effect within stated uncertainty and distinguish statistical evidence from business materiality.

scenario_families.business_template: Average order value or engagement-time experiment
scenario_families.expected_system_behaviour: Report effect size, interval uncertainty, assumptions, and an appropriate warning when the supported test is unsuitable.

scenario_families.ground_truth: known correct or incorrect allocation mechanism
scenario_families.expected_system_behaviour: Separate expected random imbalance from a likely randomization or logging defect and block overconfident interpretation for critical defects.

scenario_families.ground_truth: known effect with insufficient or borderline information
scenario_families.expected_system_behaviour: Prefer an inconclusive result, exact method, or explicit limitation over a definitive causal recommendation.

scenario_families.ground_truth: known treatment effect with known pre-treatment correlation
planned_variations: weak and strong valid pre-treatment correlation
scenario_families.expected_system_behaviour: Use valid pre-treatment information without changing the estimand, and reject or warn on post-treatment leakage.

scenario_families.business_template: Campaign, pricing, training, or onboarding intervention over time
scenario_families.ground_truth: known intervention effect under a supported parallel-trends design
scenario_families.expected_system_behaviour: Recover the stated difference-in-differences estimand while showing the design assumptions and time window.

scenario_families.business_template: Intervention analysis with differential pre-trends or anticipation
scenario_families.ground_truth: naive difference-in-differences is not supported as a causal estimate
scenario_families.expected_system_behaviour: Surface the violated or untestable assumption and avoid an unqualified causal conclusion.
Block the analysis or display a prominent warning according to the predefined severity map.

operational_target.notice: The reference hardware and method-specific workload must be recorded before this target is evaluated.

reference_and_freeze_plan.reference_calculations: Analytical formulas and pinned, independently maintained statistical libraries will be selected and recorded before the holdout freeze.
reference_and_freeze_plan.formal_holdout_rule: Run after implementation and thresholds are frozen. Preserve the first formal result even when it fails. Any corrected evaluation receives a new version.

measured_development_runs.source_commit_notice: The repository had no Git commit. The result is tied to the engine source hash and is not eligible to be described as a formal holdout.

F01_RANDOMIZED_BINARY_NULL.interpretation: Development measurement only. The observed p<0.05 rate and coverage are numerically outside the planned formal-holdout bands; no target-pass claim is made.

F02_RANDOMIZED_BINARY_EFFECT.interpretation: Development measurement only; p<0.05 rate is empirical detection frequency for this configured effect, not accuracy or business impact.

F03_RANDOMIZED_CONTINUOUS.interpretation: Development measurement only. Both observed coverage values are numerically below the planned formal-holdout band; no target-pass claim is made.

F04_SAMPLE_RATIO_MISMATCH.interpretation: Agreement is limited to the three recorded fixed fixtures and is not a calibrated sensitivity or specificity estimate.

F05_LOW_POWER_AND_SPARSE_EVENTS.interpretation: The current engine exposes uncertainty but lacks a dedicated low-power or sparse-event warning and does not implement an exact sparse-event method.

F06_PRETREATMENT_ADJUSTMENT_CUPED.interpretation: Development measurement only; independent agreement covers the implemented formulas and generated scenarios, not general causal validity.

F09_DATA_QUALITY_AND_LEAKAGE.interpretation: The policy and output narrative prohibit individual HR decisions, but the current engine does not refuse that intent at input level. The planned complete-detection target is not achieved on this fixed suite.

measured_development_runs.claim_boundary: These are synthetic development measurements and fixed-fixture observations for the recorded source hash. They are not formal holdout validation, real-world adoption, business impact, production readiness, or evidence for unimplemented families.
